about: Team decisions that are the same in every scenario. Each measured fault world adds one more entry (worlds.json, 'decision'). 'neutral' stands in the place of a world's own entry in case N.

common.title: Tracing
common.text: In this environment every request is traced (sampling 1.0).

common.title: Ports
common.text: The gateway serves the web pages and the API on port 8080. Media is served on port 8081.

common.title: Benchmark routes
common.text: The wrk2-api routes exist for benchmarks only and need no login.

common.title: Encryption between services
common.text: Calls between services are not encrypted in this environment.

common.title: Connection pools
common.text: Each service may keep up to 512 connections to each service or store it calls.

common.title: Call timeout
common.text: A call between services may take up to 10 seconds.

common.title: Posts are immutable
common.text: A post never changes after it is written.

common.title: Usernames
common.text: A username may contain letters, digits, hyphen and underscore.

common.title: Post order
common.text: A post id is unique but is not a time order. Feeds are ordered by timestamp.

common.title: Memcached
common.text: The memcached instances are caches. They may be restarted at any time.

common.title: Restart policy
common.text: Containers restart automatically when they stop.

common.title: Test data
common.text: The seeded data set is socfb-Reed98: 962 users.

common.title: Upload size
common.text: The media front end accepts uploads up to 100 MB.

common.title: Queue worker
common.text: write-home-timeline-service and RabbitMQ are not deployed.

common.title: Password storage
common.text: A password is stored as the SHA-256 hash of the password plus a per-user salt.

neutral.title: Tracing UI
neutral.text: The Jaeger UI is served on port 16686.
